nota: Prueba: reemplazar el audio de Kling de 'Llega Daniel' por efectos de ElevenLabs.

efectos.texto: Quiet upscale suburban street at golden hour in Florida, gentle warm breeze through palm fronds, distant songbirds, very soft evening crickets. No traffic, no voices, no music.
A large pickup truck V8 engine idling at low rumble, heard from across the street, then rolling slowly a few meters and settling back to idle. No horn, no music.
Calm home kitchen room tone in the evening, soft gentle sizzle of a pan on the stove, faint quiet utensil clinks far away. No voices, no music.
Soft elegant smart speaker notification chime, two gentle rising tones, clean digital, short.
Short soft smartphone notification ping, single clean modern tone, subtle.
Smart speaker voice-assistant acknowledgment sound, very short soft bright confirmation blip, clean digital.
Quiet living room room tone in the evening, very soft air conditioning hum, calm and still. No voices, no music.
A dog shifting and getting up on a soft fabric dog bed indoors, gentle rustle, short.
One single short friendly alert bark from a medium-large dog, indoors, close, clean, nothing else.
Residential garage door opener motor starting and the door rolling up on its track, heard from inside the house through a wall, muffled, steady.
An excited dog running fast across a tile floor, claws clicking and tapping quickly, happy panting, indoors.
Inside a residential garage with the big door open at sunset, outdoor evening ambience coming in, distant birds, light breeze, slight concrete room reverb. No voices, no music.
A happy excited dog greeting its owner, playful whining, happy panting and tail thumping, a couple of short joyful yips, close.
